relation: p C = V, i.e. p = V/C  (the Hawk-Dove escalation probability that is invaded from neither side)
note: Checks that a committed escalation probability is the one the committed resource value and injury cost imply. The law also proves 0 < p < 1 follows from 0 < V < C, so a design committing V >= C is outside this law's scope rather than violating it. 'violated' means the three numbers are mutually inconsistent with the Hawk-Dove mixture; it does not mean any animal escalates too often, and it says nothing about asymmetric contests, where the Bourgeois strategy is the ESS instead.
